name: Totally Cool Totally Art (TCTA) free teen art classes
what_you_do: Make art after school with real artists at a city rec center. Sessions cover painting and drawing, metals and mixed media, digital art and animation, and foam sculpture and games.
who_can_apply: Teens. The Virginia L. Brown center listing says ages 13 to 18, and the Montopolis listing says grades 7 to 12. You must sign up first, and space is limited.
duration: After school. The Montopolis class meets Monday and Wednesday, 6 to 8 p.m. Other centers set their own times.
deadline_text: 2026 to 2027 classes are listed now. Montopolis sign up opened October 1, 2026. No end date is posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Register online link on the TCTA page, or call the rec center you want to go to. Centers include Dittmar, Dove Springs, Gus Garcia, Mendez, Montopolis, Northwest and Virginia L. Brown.
notes: Program contact: Clint Hofmeister, TCTA coordinator, 512-978-2476. Each center listing has its own staff contact. Not a job.
